cancel.title: Cancel the {time} activity
cancel.noteHint: Not published: it stays in the control room log.
cancel.publish: Publish an incident notice: “The {time} activity is cancelled.”
cancel.notify: Email the registrants in 5 minutes | Email the registrant in 5 minutes | Email the {count} registrants in 5 minutes
cancel.notifyHint: Until then, you can still go back without anyone receiving anything.

end.title: End {name}'s live stream?
end.remaining: The slot is over. | 1 minute left in the slot. | {count} minutes left in the slot.
end.withPresent: {left} No one is connected. | {left} The connected person will see “Live stream ended”. | {left} The {count} connected people will see “Live stream ended”.
end.resume: A mistake? For 15 minutes, “Resume the live stream” restarts the same Zoom meeting, with the same link: viewers come back without changing anything.

restore.title: Restore the {time} activity?
restore.lead: {title}. It returns to the programme, in its slot, with its registrants.
restore.notify: Write to the registrants who received the cancellation: “The activity is going ahead after all.” | Write to the registrant who received the cancellation: “The activity is going ahead after all.” | Write to the {count} registrants who received the cancellation: “The activity is going ahead after all.”
restore.nothingElse: No notice to remove, no registrant to notify.
